source.title: Irish News, 3 June 1955, p. 1 ("Rural council election results"); Fermanagh Herald, 4 June 1955, p. 8 ("Fermanagh's public boards personnel - two contests")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Votes as printed; 100-95=5. Original citation restored 6 Nov 2026 (the 5 Nov verification had moved it because of a text-cleaning fault).

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. One contest, Derrylea; the other divisions were uncontested and are recorded from the Fermanagh Herald's full nomination list (4 June 1955, p. 8). Dresternan is not in the Herald's printed list and is not yet found (7 Nov 2026). Unionist seat retained; both candidates are also named in the Fermanagh Herald nomination list (4 June 1955, p. 8).
